headlines.title: VP Vance holds White House press briefing
headlines.description: Vice President JD Vance holds a White House press briefing, the first since Karoline Leavitt's departure as press secretary.

headlines.title: Trailblazing Feminist and Social Activist Gloria Steinem Dies at 92
headlines.description: Gloria Steinem, the pioneering feminist and journalist whose activism revolutionized the personal and professional lives of women has died at 92. Steinem dedicated her life to causes ranging from reproductive freedom and domestic violence prevention to workplace gender inequalities. NBC’s Anne Thompson looks back on her remarkable life and legacy.

headlines.title: Fox News parts ways with Maria Bartiromo
headlines.description: Fox News Media, the parent of Fox News Channel and Fox Business Network, said Thursday that it had parted ways with longtime anchor Maria Bartiromo.

headlines.title: OpenAI releases new model that it says triggered internal security measures
headlines.description: The AI giant says its new model better follows user intent and crosses a critical frontier for cybersecurity capabilities.

headlines.title: Inside a Ukrainian maternity ward as Russian strikes intensify
headlines.description: As Russia ramps up strikes on Ukrainian cities, one underground maternity ward is allowing women to deliver babies safely amid a brutal war. NBC News' Richard Engel went inside.

headlines.title: Is the Lindsay Clancy Murder Case on the Verge of a Mistrial?
headlines.description: Deliberations in the Lindsay Clancy triple murder trial are entering a sixth day despite jurors hitting an impasse twice. In a last-ditch effort to break their latest deadlock, the judge read the jury the Tuey-Rodriguez charge, which essentially asks the jury to give deliberations one last chance. NBC’s Emilie Ikeda reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: In Nepal, mourners hold symbolic cremation for missing loved ones
headlines.description: The wall of ice, water and rock that tore through Nepal last week has claimed more than 1,200 lives and left more than 4,000 missing, depriving many grieving families of a basic rite: funerals.

headlines.title: Mass Shooting in Minneapolis Leaves 2 Dead, Several Injured
headlines.description: Police say a gunman opened fire in an apartment building in downtown Minneapolis on Wednesday, killing two people and injuring several others including three police officers. NBC’s Shaquille Brewster reports for TODAY on the latest on the investigation.

headlines.title: Colin Kaepernick is done with the NFL. He isn’t done fighting.
headlines.description: Ten years after taking a knee to stand against racism and police brutality at great cost to his career and finances, Colin Kaepernick is back in the spotlight.

headlines.title: Witness video of Madison police killing raises questions of why lethal force was used
headlines.description: Local authorities said that the matter is being investigated and that the officers involved have been placed on administrative leave.

headlines.description: The AI giant says its new model better follows user intent and crosses a critical frontier for cybersecurity capabilities.

headlines.title: Arrest warrant issued for ‘Below Deck Mediterranean’ star Nathan Gallagher
headlines.description: Australian police have issued an arrest warrant for “Below Deck Mediterranean” star Nathan Gallagher after he missed a court appearance related to an alleged domestic violence incident.
